metadata.title: How to Get Your First Curative Title Deal: A Step-by-Step Guide
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
If you want to get your first curative title deal, you don't need the perfect list, expensive software, or to understand every complicated legal issue before you start.

You need to start developing the ability to recognize the problems other Real Estate investors overlook.

In this episode of the Messy Money Podcast, Courtney Fricke breaks down a practical, step-by-step process for finding and pursuing your first curative title opportunity.

Instead of starting with massive lists and trying to scale a strategy you don't understand yet, Courtney walks through how to pick a market, find distressed properties, research ownership and public records, identify potential title problems, narrow down the best opportunities, find the right people to contact, and start having conversations.

The goal isn't to become a title expert overnight. It's to start putting in the reps that teach you how to recognize where physical, financial, and ownership problems may be creating opportunities.

ATTENTION:

The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
